summary: Iteration 3: Tested Stripe Pro tier billing layer. Backend = 31/32 PASS (21 regression + 10/11 new billing). Critical bug found: GET /api/billing/status/{session_id} returns 500 because emergentintegrations.StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status() raises CheckoutError (Stripe responds 'No such checkout.session' — sessions created via /v1/checkout/sessions on the Emergent proxy are NOT retrievable by the stripe SDK's Session.retrieve in the same code path). All other billing pieces verified: /api/billing/me returns correct shape (plan, is_admin, scans_used_this_month, free_limit, scans_remaining, plan_expires_at, price_usd, current_month); demo shows plan='free', is_admin=False, scans_remaining=int; admin (onifadejosp@gmail.com, JWT-injected) shows plan='pro', is_admin=True, scans_remaining=null; POST /api/billing/checkout returns {url containing 'checkout.stripe.com', session_id} and persists fs_payments record with status='initiated', payment_status='pending', amount=29.0; invalid package_id → 400; POST /api/scrape/search for over-limit free demo → 402 with detail.code='PAYMENT_REQUIRED' and limit=5; admin scan with 8 seeded scans this month → 200 (admin override works); fresh user under-limit → 200; /api/webhook/stripe accepts POST and returns 400 for invalid signature (endpoint exists). Frontend: PlanBadge renders 'FREE · 8/5' for over-limit demo, click opens [data-testid=pricing-dialog] with [data-testid=plan-free], [data-testid=plan-pro], [data-testid=upgrade-btn] all present and Pro tier showing $29/month — visually clean. NOTE for next agent: demo user accumulated 8 real scans across iterations 1-3 in fs_jobs collection, so existing /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py 21-test regression FAILS unless demo is temporarily promoted to pro (set plan='pro' + plan_expires_at future); when temporarily promoted I confirmed all 21 regression tests still pass — billing did NOT break any existing endpoint logic. Reverted demo back to free to preserve spec scenario.

critical.issue: Returns 500 (uncaught CheckoutError) when polling status of a session that was just created via /api/billing/checkout. Root cause: emergentintegrations creates session through https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions (returns cs_test_...), but get_checkout_status calls stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve which goes to the public Stripe API and returns 404 'No such checkout.session'. Frontend useBilling hook polls this endpoint on ?session_id= URL — will surface 500s to user. Fix: wrap StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status in try/except in billing.py /status/{sid} and return {payment_status: 'pending', status: 'open', plan_applied: false} on CheckoutError, OR configure StripeCheckout to also retrieve via the emergent proxy.

minor.issue: is_admin field returned as truthy string when ADMIN_EMAIL is set (Python short-circuit: `ADMIN_EMAIL and ...` returns the string itself when False side, or boolean True). Currently tests treat as truthy but for clean API contract, wrap in bool() in get_plan_status. Minor — frontend coerces to bool anyway.

integration_issues.issue: useBilling hook polls /billing/status/{sid} which currently 500s — user returning from Stripe will see error toasts and plan will never be marked applied even after successful payment. Depends on backend critical bug above.

rca_of_the_issue: Stripe status 500: The emergentintegrations Stripe wrapper creates sessions through an Emergent proxy URL (https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions) but the get_checkout_status method calls the public Stripe SDK's Session.retrieve which hits api.stripe.com directly with sk_test_emergent — the public API has no record of those proxy-created sessions, returning 404 'No such checkout.session'. The CheckoutError this raises is not caught in billing.py /status/{sid}, propagating as a 500 to the client. Mitigation: catch CheckoutError and return the persisted DB state as pending; or escalate to provider so retrieve also routes via proxy.
